name: Marching Cubes 33
definition: An algorithm suggested by Chernyaev (1995) that addresses internal ambiguities of the trilinear interpolant and uses an enlarged lookup table with more sub-cases than the original 15 configurations.
summary: Marching Cubes 33 is an isosurface extraction algorithm that resolves topological ambiguities in the original method by expanding the lookup table to 33 entries, ensuring the generated mesh topology matches the underlying trilinear function.
